summary.text: Anissa Knight Wiseman is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 175 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent John LaHood.
She also ran for the seat in 2024, losing to LaHood in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Anissa Knight Wiseman was the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 175 in 2024, when incumbent John LaHood defeated her in the November 5 general election.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for the seat on May 19, 2026.
